decisions: Workflow: every closed chunk = `workflow ticket new --repo <repo> --type fix|feature|docs --summary "..." --status closed`, then commit with subject ending in the ticket id "(G.AWPN-Tnn)" (a commit hook enforces it; ticket-log commits are tagged with the latest ticket they record). Deploy = `dotnet build src/GTFO.AbsurdWeapons/GTFO.AbsurdWeapons.csproj -v minimal -p:Retries=0` retried while GTFO.exe locks the DLL; compile check via -p:OutputPath=$PWD/.scratch-build/. Edit files with Python using newline='' to preserve line endings. Every changed default gets a ConfigMigrations entry (latest is 11). Dist zips: run each repo's build.ps1 (EZ v14 -> dist/GTFO.EZ-14.0.0.zip, AbsurdWeapons v1 -> dist/GTFO.AbsurdWeapons-1.0.0.zip). Settled design: (!) guns use real ammo, start 100% on first equip in a level and keep per-weapon ammo across PageUp/PageDown (starting gear joins the cycle on first swap; Home restores); slot select keys 1-4 pressed again cycle that slot (SlotKeysCycle); beam guns (lasers, Chain Lightning, Shrink Beam) have no magazine, drain 1% reserve per 0.5 s (StreamPercentPerSecond 2), never reload; Tentacle Cannon shots free, only enemy bites cost a round; Rocket Launcher no ADS, right-click detonates oldest rocket in flight (chains); Railgun = static double helix that fades (no center line); Hand Grenades finite: none at drop-in, 1 per loot pickup, carry max 6, bots ignore them (by design); Stim Pack (item 1204, Doom overheal up to 200%) exists but is OFF by default for now in AbsurdWeapons and fully removed from GTFO.EZ; loot mix = Hand Grenade weight 4 + health/tool/ammo kits weight 1 each, kits from loot hold 20% (KitSize), SpawnsPerZoneMultiplier 1.5; artifacts spawn vanilla (GTFO.EZ v14 artifact buffs depend on them); AbsurdWeapons' GameData patches run after GTFO.EZ and win clashes. Another Claude window also commits to these repos - always git fetch/check status before edits and pushes.
